contexts.text: The spirit receives much more excellent faculties when it is separated from the body. AC 1718:end.
He had acquired a sphere of excellence in preference to others.
The excellence of the interior memory in preference to the exterior one.

If anyone loves himself in preference to others, and from this love studies to excel others in moral and civil life... the evil of this love of self is that with which good and truth can be commingled...
In this gift (of perception) one man excels another. They who excel less are they who... But they who excel more are they who...
Thou shalt not excel () = that it has not glory and Power.
This speech excels that of words, as...
The multitude of excellence () = the Divine as to power over those things which set themselves in opposition to it.
Nothing can be compared to (the style of the Word) in excellence...
The nature of the excellence of Spirits in preference to men... Hence it is evident how greatly man excels when he is in his spirit. SE 4166. SE 4318.
On account of the excellence of this love... CL 333.
As the Knowledge of the Lord surpasses all Knowledges in excellence.
With a difference in excellence and beauty according to degrees.
